claims.text: Fomori were born mortal, apart from supernatural fomori such as werewolves or vampires lastingly possessed by a Bane, and have no abilities beyond their Powers and Taints.
Unless a fomor buys Regeneration, it heals like a normal human, which can be fatal against Garou.
Fomori cannot buy Numina because the Banes in their souls block such powers, with rare exceptions such as True Faith and the Brain Eaters.

title: Fomor Powers
summary: Selected Powers of the Wyrm’s servants.

claims.text: One mind-reading Power costs a Willpower point and Intelligence + Intimidation at difficulty 6, resisted by Willpower; one success reads surface thoughts, two recent memories, three or more anything the target knows.
Molecular Weakening, 4 points, follows a successful hit with a Willpower point and Perception + Medicine or Repair at difficulty 8 to double the damage before soak.
Mouth of the Wyrm, 4 points, lets the fomor swallow something as big as a medium dog or a small person; a living victim suffocates and can cut its way out only with natural weapons.
Nightmare Command, 3 points, twists a familiar sleeper’s dreams into terrors and can drive the victim to madness in weeks, but fails if the fomor is disturbed.

title: Enticers
summary: Seductive fomori made by Siren Cosmetics.

claims.text: Enticers can seduce any living creature through pheromones and images of perfection drawn from the prey’s mind, and prefer to set rivals fighting over them or lead them into ambush.
Without their powers they look human but for a row of barbed teeth.
They are said to come from a Pentex subsidiary, Siren Cosmetics, whose prize supply of special makeup or cologne transforms contest winners within about a month and leaves them addicted.

title: Supernatural fomori
summary: Banes that possess werewolves, vampires and others.

claims.text: Possessing a supernatural host is much harder: Garou can fight Banes in the Umbra, Spirit mages can repel them, mummies have divided souls and psychics can shield themselves, while most vampires have no such defence.
The Bane makes a Gnosis roll against the host’s Willpower + 2, then needs twenty-four undisturbed hours and spends a permanent Willpower point, which also lowers the new fomor’s Willpower.

An unwilling host might be freed by death, by the Silver Lake for Garou, or perhaps by a vampire enduring the sun for a few minutes; a host who welcomed the Bane can never be separated from it short of killing both.

title: Action Bill tattoos
summary: Pentex toys that turn children into fomori.

claims.text: Action Bill is a werewolf-killing TV hero on Pentex’s OmniTV, part of a campaign to unsettle society while blaming the Garou.
Each temporary tattoo holds a fragment of a Bane; once three to five are on one child they cannot be removed and the Bane reassembles, slowly corrupting the child into a fomor.
Child fomori hide until the Bane has full control, and Garou who rescue abused children can be in for nasty surprises.
